answer_1.quote: Retrieval-augmented generation has gained attention for its ability to incorporate information from external knowledge sources during the inference stage. By combining retrieval-based methods with generative models, this approach can improve the relevance, coherence, and factual accuracy of text generation.

answer_2.quote: Question-answering tasks typically employ Exact Match (EM) and F1 as evaluation metrics... Our IB score, on the contrary, is a comprehensive and versatile evaluation metric capable of assessing the conciseness and correctness of generated contents on a semantic level compared to ground answers, leveraging the capabilities of advanced large language models.
